verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for an OS distribution. Fedora's own docs only glancingly imply first-party command-line tooling: packages and runtimes are "ready for use with just a single command," and it ships container tools and a Container_Toolbox subvariant. No CLI is named or documented, and nothing ties it to AI-native or agentic workflows. Missing for 10: a named and documented official CLI (commands, reference docs), evidence of scriptable or agent-friendly use such as machine-readable output or automation guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.
